name: Toast Race Condition: Replace waitForTimeout with Explicit Waits
task: Fix the flaky toast notification tests in tests/toast.spec.ts. The toast element appears with a delay after clicking add-to-cart. The current implementation in pages/InventoryPage.ts uses waitForTimeout(200) which is flaky. Fix the root cause using proper Playwright waits -- do NOT increase timeout values or add more waitForTimeout calls.
passCriteria: Uses state-based waits (waitForSelector, toBeVisible, etc.) instead
Toast tests pass and reliably detect the notification
No new waitForTimeout or hard-coded delays added
failCriteria: Increases timeout values instead of fixing the wait strategy
Keeps or adds additional waitForTimeout calls
